name: Proxmox Backup Server Detection Suite
name_zh: Proxmox Backup Server 偵測套組
summary: Failed backups, verification errors, full datastores, deleted and unprotected backups (the ransomware pattern), API token, permission and second-factor changes, configuration changes made on the shell, logins and undelivered notifications on Proxmox Backup Server, for which Wazuh has no rules.
summary_zh: Proxmox Backup Server 的備份失敗、驗證錯誤、datastore 空間不足、備份被刪除或解除保護（勒索軟體的手法）、API token、權限與雙因素變更、在 shell 上做的設定變更、登入與通知送達失敗；Wazuh 內建完全沒有對應規則。
notes: Wazuh ships nothing for Proxmox Backup Server. Its daemons write to syslog, where a removable datastore left unplugged repeats one line every minute and where failed logins, refused requests and the errors of running tasks are copied, and the parts that matter are in three files of their own: logins (api/auth.log), REST API requests (api/access.log) and the result of every finished task (tasks/archive). The pack decodes all four and, through the pbs agent group, watches /etc/proxmox-backup.

Task results, from the task archive: a backup that fails is level 7, and level 10 when the same backup group fails three times in a day (measured: one container failed three times a day for six weeks). A verification that finds corrupt or missing chunks is level 12; a verification that did not complete is level 6. Failed garbage collection, sync jobs and tape backups are level 10; failed prunes and tape restores level 7; any task that fails because the disk is full level 12. Warnings stay at level 0 except for garbage collection (level 7, usually missing chunks), sync, tape and verify (level 5) and prune (level 3). Since Proxmox Backup Server 3.3 the ERROR lines of a running task are also copied to syslog: a verification that finds a corrupt or missing chunk is level 10 there (at most once an hour), before the task ends and without the agent group.

Destructive and administrative tasks: a datastore removed is level 10; a disk wiped level 8; a shell on the server opened from the web interface level 5; a service stopped level 5; removable datastores mounted or unmounted, storage created, backups moved to another group or namespace (4.2) and certificates ordered or renewed level 3. Deleting snapshots, groups and namespaces is not a task: those are REST API calls (next note).

REST API changes, from the access log (2xx answers unless stated): API tokens created, changed or removed level 10; users, permissions, realms and two-factor settings level 8, and level 10 when a second factor of an account with a built-in administrator name is removed or its TFA lockout cleared; datastore configuration level 8, and level 12 when a datastore is removed together with its data; backups deleted level 8, and level 12 for ten deletions from one address in five minutes; prune jobs (retention) level 8; ad-hoc push or pull syncs, S3 endpoints and sync encryption keys level 8; a notification endpoint or matcher removed, a verification job removed and a tape encryption key removed level 8; protection and ownership of backups, remotes and sync jobs, certificates, other notification settings and tape encryption keys level 6; network, DNS and time settings level 5. A change refused with 403 to an authenticated user or token is level 5. The agent group keeps only requests that change something (measured: 297,122 lines in three days, none of them a change).

Deleting backups and their protection (the Pay2Key pattern of 2025: a compromised Proxmox VE node first removes the protection of its backups, then deletes them through the node's storage token). A protection change is level 6 (the web interface and Proxmox VE send the new value in the request body, so the direction is unknown) and level 10 when the query string shows that protection was removed (proxmox-backup-client). Backups deleted, or a deletion refused, within ten minutes of a protection change from the same address is level 12. A deletion or protection change refused to an authenticated user or token (any 4xx) is level 7 and five in ten minutes from one address level 12: with the documented ransomware protection, one token per Proxmox VE cluster with only DatastoreBackup, this is exactly what ransomware on a node produces. A refusal because the snapshot is protected is also level 10 from syslog.

Logins: a successful login is not an alert by itself. It is recorded at level 2 and alerts at level 3 for the built-in administrator root@pam (and any root, admin or administrator account of another realm), at level 3 the first time an ordinary account logs in on the server (first-time-seen per account and agent), at level 5 when the login comes from an address outside the private ranges, at level 10 after three failed passwords for the same account in ten minutes (level 12 for an administrator) and at level 12 when the address had a brute-force alert in the last ten minutes. A failed password is level 5, six from one address in five minutes level 10. A correct password followed by a wrong second factor is level 8, and a locked second factor (8 wrong TOTP codes, or 100 failed tries for all factors) level 10: Proxmox Backup Server itself tells no one. The web interface renews its ticket every 15 minutes and each renewal is a login, so an administrator's open browser tab is four level 3 alerts an hour (measured: 2,220 of 2,221 logins in four and a half years were root@pam). A request refused for an expired or missing ticket is level 2. A request refused for a wrong API token is level 5, and level 7 when one address keeps doing it: that is almost always a Proxmox VE node whose stored token no longer works, and its backups fail. These refusals are deliberately not in the authentication_failed group, so the built-in rule 40111 does not turn a misconfigured node into a brute-force alert.

Where the login data is: auth.log has the account but not the address, and the access log has the address of the login request but not the account (it is in the request body). Failures are written to syslog as well as to auth.log; since 1.2 the failure rules read both, and the pbs group reads only the successful logins from auth.log, so a failure is counted once and a server outside the group still reports failed logins (before 1.2 the syslog copy was dropped). The PAM copy of a failed pam realm login (built-in rule 5503, level 5) is recorded at level 2, because the pack reports the same failure with the account. The external-address and brute-force-then-login rules come from the access log and name the address, and the administrator and first-login rules come from auth.log and name the account; no single line says both, so an administrator logging in from outside is level 5, not more. Private ranges are 10/8, 172.16/12, 192.168/16, 127/8, 100.64/10, fc00::/7 and fe80::/10. The IPv6 loopback is deliberately not in the address lists: in Wazuh 4.14.7 a srcip of ::1 matches every IPv4 address; a login over ::1 comes from the server itself. The built-in rule 40112 (success after failures) never applies to rules of a pack, which is why the pack has its own. Behind a reverse proxy every login comes from the proxy's address unless the proxy's real-IP header is configured (setup).

Daemon messages: a notification that could not be delivered is level 7 (Proxmox Backup Server has no other way to report a failed job). A datastore that cannot be opened is level 10, at most once an hour; when only the datastore configuration lock could not be taken (measured: 8 a year, all while the services stopped for a reboot) level 3. A datastore that is not mounted is logged once a minute by its garbage collection schedule (measured: 40,978 lines in four weeks from one unplugged removable datastore); each line is recorded at level 2, and rule 131812 reports it at level 5 once it has lasted an hour, then at most once a day; removing the schedule stops it. A scheduled job the scheduler could not start (no task is created, so the archive is silent) is level 10, at most once an hour; a failed task scheduler (no scheduled job runs at all) level 12; a job configuration or schedule it cannot read level 7. Ten malformed connections to the API port from one address in two minutes are level 6. A copy of a task's error in syslog is level 3, because the task archive reports the same failure with the task type, the backup group and the user.

Configuration files (since 1.2): the pbs group watches /etc/proxmox-backup in real time (the default syscheck scans /etc every 12 hours). Users, permissions, API tokens, passwords, realms and second factors, datastores, remotes, sync jobs and S3 endpoints, prune and verification jobs and notification settings changed on disk are level 8 each. This is the only record of a change made with proxmox-backup-manager on the server's shell, which never reaches the access log; a change made in the web interface is reported by both. The alert carries a diff only for the files without secrets (user.cfg, acl.cfg, datastore.cfg, prune.cfg, verification.cfg, sync.cfg, notifications.cfg), so a shortened retention shows its keep-* values; the others (shadow.json, token.shadow, tfa.json, domains.cfg, remote.cfg, s3.cfg, keys) are compared by hash only. Lock files, the temporary files every write renames into place and the subscription status are left out. Measured on one server: no change in three weeks apart from the subscription status.

Datastore disk usage: Proxmox Backup Server writes nothing when a datastore gets close to full (its binaries contain no such message); the first thing it logs is No space left on device, level 12. Fill levels therefore come from df: 90 to 97 per cent is level 10, 98 per cent and more level 12, each at most every 6 hours. With no setup, the df -P command in every Linux agent's default configuration covers mount points under /mnt/datastore/ (disks formatted by Proxmox Backup Server, and removable datastores). A datastore on a ZFS dataset or any other mount (measured on one site: its only datastore was a ZFS pool mounted at its own path) is not recognisable in df -P and stays invisible until one of two optional steps: add the command with the alias jt-pbs-datastores to the server's own ossec.conf, which runs df on every datastore path Proxmox Backup Server has configured and follows new datastores; or list the mount point in etc/lists/jt-pbs-datastore-mounts. The built-in rule 531 covers only /dev/ devices at 100 per cent and drops paths that contain usb.

Versions: written from Proxmox Backup Server 4.2.2 logs and checked against the 4.2.8 source (October 2026). The auth.log, access log and task archive formats are unchanged since 1.x and work on 2.x as well; the syslog copies of task errors exist since 3.3; the real-IP header for reverse proxies since 4.1.4; S3, push sync encryption keys and the move tasks are 4.x. No Proxmox Backup Server vulnerability is in the CISA KEV catalogue (checked October 2026); the one with a CVSS of 8.8, CVE-2023-43320 (a second-factor bypass, fixed after 3.0), leaves no log trace, so keep the server updated.

Not covered: the content of task logs (which chunk is corrupt, which snapshot failed) is one file per task and is not collected, so a rule says where to look rather than what broke. Wazuh cannot alert on something that did not happen: a backup group that silently stops receiving backups (a backup job disabled on Proxmox VE) raises nothing. Certificate expiry is not logged by Proxmox Backup Server. A datastore whose notification mode is legacy-sendmail mails its job results directly; a failed delivery then shows only in the server's mail log. Wazuh rules cannot be limited to an agent group, so the disk usage decoder adds two fields to the df -P lines of every agent; only the mount points above raise alerts.
Proxmox VE has a pack of its own, jt-proxmox; a failed backup is reported on both sides when both packs are installed (by the node that sent it and by the server that received it).

Cross-pack login groups (patch release): jt_auth_success on 131801, 131807, 131808; jt_auth_failure on 131802; jt_auth_lockout on 131825. They let jt-account-guard correlate logins across services and jt-ioc look up the address of every tagged successful login; levels and matching are unchanged, and without those packs the groups do nothing. One copy per login: successes are tagged on the auth.log line that names the account (131801, 131807, 131808), not on the API access line (131875, 131876, address only). A wrong second factor (131824) is not a failed password and is not tagged.
notes_zh: Wazuh 對 Proxmox Backup Server 沒有任何解碼器或規則。它的服務程式寫進 syslog（未掛載的卸除式 datastore 每分鐘重複一行；登入失敗、被拒絕的請求與執行中任務的錯誤也會複製一份到這裡），真正重要的內容在三個獨立檔案：登入（api/auth.log）、REST API 請求（api/access.log）、每個完成任務的結果（tasks/archive）。本套件四者都解碼，並透過 pbs agent 群組監看 /etc/proxmox-backup。

任務結果取自任務封存檔：備份失敗為 level 7，同一個備份群組一天內失敗三次則為 level 10（實測：某個容器連續六週每天失敗三次）。驗證發現 chunk 損壞或遺失為 level 12，驗證未完成為 level 6。垃圾回收、同步工作、磁帶備份失敗為 level 10；prune 與磁帶還原失敗為 level 7；任何因磁碟已滿而失敗的任務為 level 12。警告維持 level 0，但垃圾回收（level 7，通常是 chunk 遺失）、同步、磁帶與驗證（level 5）、prune（level 3）除外。自 Proxmox Backup Server 3.3 起，執行中任務的 ERROR 行也會複製到 syslog：驗證發現 chunk 損壞或遺失時，在 syslog 為 level 10（每小時最多一次），任務結束前就會出現，也不需要 agent 群組。

破壞性與管理類任務：移除 datastore 為 level 10；抹除磁碟為 level 8；從網頁介面開啟伺服器 shell 為 level 5；停止服務為 level 5；卸除式 datastore 掛載或卸載、建立儲存區、把備份移到另一個群組或 namespace（4.2）、申請或更新憑證為 level 3。刪除 snapshot、群組與 namespace 不是任務，而是 REST API 呼叫（見下一則）。

REST API 變更取自存取記錄（除另有說明外只看 2xx 回應）：建立、修改或移除 API token 為 level 10；使用者、權限、realm 與雙因素設定為 level 8，若是移除內建管理者名稱帳號的第二因素或解除其 TFA 鎖定則為 level 10；datastore 設定為 level 8，連同資料一起移除 datastore 為 level 12；刪除備份為 level 8，同一位址五分鐘內刪除十次為 level 12；prune 工作（保留原則）為 level 8；臨時的 push 或 pull 同步、S3 端點與同步加密金鑰為 level 8；移除通知端點或比對規則、移除驗證工作、移除磁帶加密金鑰為 level 8；備份的保護與擁有者、remote 與同步工作、憑證、其他通知設定、磁帶加密金鑰為 level 6；網路、DNS、時間設定為 level 5。已驗證的使用者或 token 被以 403 拒絕的變更為 level 5。agent 群組只保留會改變東西的請求（實測：三天 297,122 行，沒有一行是變更）。

刪除備份與備份保護（2025 年 Pay2Key 的手法：被入侵的 Proxmox VE 節點先解除自己備份的保護，再用節點的儲存區 token 刪除）。變更保護為 level 6（網頁介面與 Proxmox VE 把新值放在請求內容，看不出是設定還是解除），查詢字串顯示解除保護時（proxmox-backup-client）為 level 10。同一位址在變更保護後十分鐘內刪除備份（或刪除被拒絕）為 level 12。已驗證的使用者或 token 刪除備份或變更保護被拒絕（任何 4xx）為 level 7，同一位址十分鐘內五次為 level 12：依官方的勒索軟體防護建議，每個 Proxmox VE 叢集一個只有 DatastoreBackup 權限的 token，節點上的勒索軟體產生的正是這種結果。因 snapshot 受保護而被拒絕，在 syslog 另為 level 10。

登入：成功登入本身不是告警，記錄為 level 2。內建管理者 root@pam（以及其他 realm 中名為 root、admin、administrator 的帳號）登入為 level 3；一般帳號第一次登入這台伺服器為 level 3（以帳號與 agent 判斷首次出現）；來源位址不在私有網段為 level 5；同一帳號十分鐘內密碼錯誤三次後登入成功為 level 10（管理者為 level 12）；來源位址在十分鐘內觸發過暴力破解告警為 level 12。密碼錯誤為 level 5，同一位址五分鐘內六次為 level 10。密碼正確但第二因素錯誤為 level 8，第二因素被鎖定（TOTP 錯 8 次，或所有因素失敗 100 次）為 level 10：Proxmox Backup Server 本身不會通知任何人。網頁介面每 15 分鐘更新一次 ticket，每次更新都是一次登入，所以管理者開著的瀏覽器分頁每小時會產生四筆 level 3 告警（實測：四年半內 2,221 次登入有 2,220 次是 root@pam）。因 ticket 過期或缺少而被拒絕的請求為 level 2。因 API token 錯誤被拒絕為 level 5，同一位址持續發生則為 level 7：這幾乎都是某台 Proxmox VE 節點儲存的 token 已失效，該節點的備份會失敗。這類拒絕刻意不放進 authentication_failed 群組，避免內建規則 40111 把設定錯誤的節點當成暴力破解。

登入資料的位置：auth.log 有帳號但沒有位址，存取記錄有登入請求的位址但沒有帳號（帳號在請求內容中）。登入失敗同時寫進 syslog 與 auth.log；自 1.2 起，失敗的規則兩者都讀，而 pbs 群組只從 auth.log 讀取成功登入，因此每次失敗只計算一次，不在群組中的伺服器也會回報登入失敗（1.2 之前 syslog 的副本會被丟掉）。pam realm 登入失敗時 PAM 另寫的一行（內建規則 5503，level 5）記錄為 level 2，因為本套件已以帳號回報同一次失敗。「外部位址」與「暴力破解後登入」取自存取記錄、指出位址；「管理者」與「首次登入」取自 auth.log、指出帳號；沒有一行同時具備兩者，所以管理者從外部登入是 level 5，不會更高。私有網段為 10/8、172.16/12、192.168/16、127/8、100.64/10、fc00::/7、fe80::/10。IPv6 loopback 刻意不放進位址清單：Wazuh 4.14.7 中 srcip 寫 ::1 會比對到所有 IPv4 位址；經 ::1 的登入來自伺服器本身。內建規則 40112（失敗後成功）永遠不會套用到套件的規則，所以套件自己寫了一條。在反向代理後面時，除非設定代理的真實 IP 標頭（見部署說明），否則所有登入都來自代理的位址。

服務程式訊息：通知無法送達為 level 7（Proxmox Backup Server 沒有其他方式回報工作失敗）。無法開啟 datastore 為 level 10，每小時最多一次；只是拿不到 datastore 設定的鎖時（實測：一年 8 次，都在服務因重新開機而停止時）為 level 3。datastore 未掛載時，它的垃圾回收排程每分鐘記錄一次（實測：一個沒插上的卸除式 datastore 四週產生 40,978 行）；每行記錄為 level 2，持續一小時後規則 131812 以 level 5 回報，之後每天最多一次；移除該排程即可停止。排程器無法啟動排定的工作（不會建立任務，所以封存檔不會有記錄）為 level 10，每小時最多一次；任務排程器本身失敗（所有排定的工作都不會執行）為 level 12；無法讀取工作設定或排程為 level 7。同一位址兩分鐘內對 API 連接埠建立十次異常連線為 level 6。syslog 裡任務錯誤的副本為 level 3，因為任務封存檔會以任務類型、備份群組與使用者回報同一個失敗。

設定檔（自 1.2 起）：pbs 群組即時監看 /etc/proxmox-backup（預設的 syscheck 每 12 小時掃描一次 /etc）。磁碟上的使用者、權限、API token、密碼、realm 與第二因素，datastore、remote、同步工作與 S3 端點，prune 與驗證工作，以及通知設定被變更時，各為 level 8。在伺服器 shell 上用 proxmox-backup-manager 做的變更不會出現在存取記錄，這是唯一的紀錄；在網頁介面做的變更兩邊都會回報。只有不含機密的檔案（user.cfg、acl.cfg、datastore.cfg、prune.cfg、verification.cfg、sync.cfg、notifications.cfg）的告警附有差異內容，所以縮短的保留原則會顯示 keep-* 的值；其他檔案（shadow.json、token.shadow、tfa.json、domains.cfg、remote.cfg、s3.cfg、金鑰）只比對雜湊。鎖定檔、每次寫入時改名就位的暫存檔與訂閱狀態不監看。某台伺服器實測：三週內除了訂閱狀態之外沒有任何變更。

datastore 磁碟用量：Proxmox Backup Server 在 datastore 快滿時不會寫任何記錄（其執行檔中沒有這類訊息）；最早出現的是 No space left on device，level 12。因此用量取自 df：90% 到 97% 為 level 10，98% 以上為 level 12，各自每 6 小時最多一次。不需設定時，每個 Linux agent 預設設定中的 df -P 指令涵蓋 /mnt/datastore/ 底下的掛載點（Proxmox Backup Server 格式化的磁碟與卸除式 datastore）。放在 ZFS dataset 或其他掛載點的 datastore（某站台實測：唯一的 datastore 是掛在自己路徑的 ZFS pool）在 df -P 中無法辨識，在完成以下兩個選用步驟之一前都看不到：在伺服器自己的 ossec.conf 加上別名為 jt-pbs-datastores 的指令，它會對 Proxmox Backup Server 設定的每個 datastore 路徑執行 df，新增的 datastore 也會自動涵蓋；或把掛載點列在 etc/lists/jt-pbs-datastore-mounts。內建規則 531 只看 /dev/ 裝置且達 100% 才觸發，並會丟掉路徑含 usb 的項目。

版本：依 Proxmox Backup Server 4.2.2 的記錄撰寫，並對照 4.2.8 的原始碼（2026 年 10 月）。auth.log、存取記錄與任務封存檔的格式自 1.x 起沒有改變，2.x 也適用；任務錯誤複製到 syslog 自 3.3 起；反向代理的真實 IP 標頭自 4.1.4 起；S3、push 同步加密金鑰與移動任務為 4.x 才有。CISA KEV 目錄中沒有任何 Proxmox Backup Server 的弱點（2026 年 10 月查證）；CVSS 8.8 的 CVE-2023-43320（第二因素繞過，3.0 之後修正）不會留下任何記錄，請保持伺服器更新。

未涵蓋：任務記錄的內容（哪個 chunk 損壞、哪個 snapshot 失敗）是每個任務一個檔案，不收集，所以規則只指出去哪裡看，不說明壞了什麼。Wazuh 無法對「沒有發生的事」告警：某個備份群組悄悄不再收到備份（Proxmox VE 上的備份工作被停用）不會有任何告警。Proxmox Backup Server 不記錄憑證到期。通知模式為 legacy-sendmail 的 datastore 會直接寄送工作結果，寄送失敗只會出現在伺服器的郵件記錄。Wazuh 規則無法限定 agent 群組，因此磁碟用量解碼器會為每台 agent 的 df -P 記錄加上兩個欄位；只有上述掛載點會產生告警。
Proxmox VE 另有自己的套件 jt-proxmox；兩個套件都安裝時，備份失敗會在兩端各回報一次（送出備份的節點與接收備份的伺服器）。

跨套件登入群組（修補版）：jt_auth_success：131801, 131807, 131808；jt_auth_failure：131802；jt_auth_lockout：131825。讓 jt-account-guard 跨服務關聯登入、jt-ioc 查詢每一筆加標記的成功登入來源位址；等級與比對條件不變，沒有安裝這些套件時群組沒有作用。每次登入只標一份：成功登入標在有帳號的 auth.log 那行（131801、131807、131808），不標 API 存取記錄那行（131875、131876，只有位址）。第二因素錯誤（131824）不是密碼錯誤，不加標記。
author: Jason Tools

agent_group.name: pbs
agent_group.description: The Proxmox Backup Server logs outside syslog: logins, REST API changes and task results

setup.title: Install the pack and reload the ruleset on every node
setup.title_zh: 安裝套件並在所有節點重新載入規則集
setup.body: Install from this page, then use Reload Ruleset on the Rules tab. A cluster synchronises rule files but does not reload the workers. The pack declares the list etc/lists/jt-pbs-datastore-mounts in ossec.conf; on a cluster, declare it on the workers too.
setup.body_zh: 在本頁安裝後，到「規則」分頁按「重新載入規則集」。叢集只同步規則檔、不會重載 worker。套件會在 ossec.conf 宣告清單 etc/lists/jt-pbs-datastore-mounts；叢集環境請在 worker 上也宣告。

setup.title: Assign the backup servers to the pbs group
setup.title_zh: 把備份伺服器加入 pbs 群組
setup.body: The group collects the successful logins from the login log, the REST API access log and the task archive under /var/log/proxmox-backup, and watches /etc/proxmox-backup in real time. On the agent it drops reads (GET, HEAD), the log upload and notes update that end every backup and successful backup and restore sessions, which leaves a few lines a day; login ticket requests are kept because they are the only record of a login's address. Failed logins and daemon messages come from /var/log/syslog, which the agent reads already; on a server that logs only to journald, see the journald step below. Nothing changes on the backup server itself.
setup.body_zh: 群組會收集 /var/log/proxmox-backup 底下登入記錄中的成功登入、REST API 存取記錄與任務封存檔，並即時監看 /etc/proxmox-backup。agent 端會丟掉讀取請求（GET、HEAD）、每次備份結尾的記錄上傳與 notes 更新，以及成功的備份與還原工作階段，每天只剩幾行；登入 ticket 請求會保留，因為那是唯一記下登入來源位址的地方。登入失敗與服務程式訊息來自 /var/log/syslog，agent 本來就有在讀；若伺服器只寫 journald，請見下方 journald 的步驟。備份伺服器本身不需要任何變更。
setup.verify: Open a shell from the server's web interface (Administration, Shell) and close it. Expect rule 131857 (level 5) on the manager when the window closes. Logging in as root@pam raises 131807 (level 3).
setup.verify_zh: 從伺服器網頁介面（管理 → Shell）開啟 shell 後關閉。視窗關閉時 manager 端應出現規則 131857（level 5）。以 root@pam 登入會出現 131807（level 3）。

setup.title: After updating to 1.2: restart the agents of the pbs group
setup.title_zh: 更新到 1.2 之後：重新啟動 pbs 群組的 agent
setup.body: 1.2 changes the group's agent.conf: auth.log is read for successful logins only (failures now come from syslog, so each one is counted once) and /etc/proxmox-backup is watched in real time. The agent applies a new group configuration when it restarts; check afterwards that the FIM alerts arrive. A site that keeps its own copy of the group's agent.conf (the update shows it as modified and does not replace it) must add the restrict line to the auth.log localfile itself, otherwise every failed login is counted twice and the brute-force rule fires after three attempts instead of six; copy the syscheck block as well. Restarting the Wazuh agent does not interrupt backups.
setup.body_zh: 1.2 變更了群組的 agent.conf：auth.log 只讀取成功登入（失敗改由 syslog 取得，因此每次只計算一次），並即時監看 /etc/proxmox-backup。agent 重新啟動時才會套用新的群組設定；之後請確認 FIM 告警有送達。若站台保留自己版本的群組 agent.conf（更新時顯示為「已修改」且不會取代），必須自行在 auth.log 的 localfile 加上 restrict 這一行，否則每次登入失敗會被計算兩次，暴力破解規則在三次而非六次後就觸發；syscheck 區塊也請一併複製。重新啟動 Wazuh agent 不會中斷備份。
setup.code:
/var/ossec/bin/agent_control -R -u <agent_id>

# in a site's own agent.conf, the auth.log localfile:
<restrict type="PCRE2">: successful auth for user '</restrict>
setup.verify: On the backup server run: proxmox-backup-manager acl update / Audit --auth-id <an existing user>, then remove it again. Expect rule 131895 (level 8) on the manager within seconds, with the change in the diff.
setup.verify_zh: 在備份伺服器上執行 proxmox-backup-manager acl update / Audit --auth-id <既有的使用者>，再移除。數秒內 manager 端應出現規則 131895（level 8），差異內容中可看到這項變更。

setup.title: A server without /var/log/syslog: read the Proxmox Backup Server units from journald
setup.title_zh: 沒有 /var/log/syslog 的伺服器：從 journald 讀取 Proxmox Backup Server 的服務
setup.body: Debian 12 and 13 installs without rsyslog write only to journald, and then every syslog-based rule of this pack (failed logins, brute force, datastores, the scheduler, notifications) sees nothing. Check with ls /var/log/syslog on the server. If the file does not exist and the agent's own ossec.conf has no journald localfile, add the localfile below to /var/ossec/etc/ossec.conf (inside ossec_config) and restart the agent. Wazuh writes the journald entries in syslog form, so the decoders are unchanged. Do not add it where /var/log/syslog exists: every message would arrive twice and the brute-force rules would count each failure twice. Nothing changes in Proxmox Backup Server.
setup.body_zh: 未安裝 rsyslog 的 Debian 12、13 只寫入 journald，此時本套件所有依賴 syslog 的規則（登入失敗、暴力破解、datastore、排程器、通知）都看不到任何東西。請在伺服器上以 ls /var/log/syslog 確認。若該檔不存在，且 agent 自己的 ossec.conf 沒有 journald 的 localfile，請把下面的 localfile 加到 /var/ossec/etc/ossec.conf（放在 ossec_config 內）並重新啟動 agent。Wazuh 會把 journald 的項目寫成 syslog 形式，解碼器不需更動。/var/log/syslog 存在時請勿加入：每則訊息都會收到兩次，暴力破解規則也會把每次失敗算兩次。Proxmox Backup Server 不需任何變更。
setup.verify: Log in to the web interface with a wrong password once. Expect rule 131802 (level 5) on the manager.
setup.verify_zh: 以錯誤的密碼登入網頁介面一次，manager 端應出現規則 131802（level 5）。

setup.title: Behind a reverse proxy: let Proxmox Backup Server log the client's address
setup.title_zh: 在反向代理後面：讓 Proxmox Backup Server 記錄真實的來源位址
setup.body: When the web interface is reached through a reverse proxy, every login, failure and API request is logged with the proxy's address: the external-address rule never fires, the brute-force rule counts every user together, and the optional block would block the proxy. Proxmox Backup Server 4.1.4 and later read the client address from a header when the request comes from an allowed proxy. Add the override below on the backup server (use the header your proxy sets and its address), then restart proxmox-backup-proxy outside the backup window: running backup and restore sessions are cut. Only addresses in PROXY_REAL_IP_ALLOW_FROM may set the header, so a client cannot forge its address. Not needed when nothing is proxied.
setup.body_zh: 若網頁介面透過反向代理存取，所有登入、失敗與 API 請求都會以代理的位址記錄：外部位址的規則永遠不會觸發，暴力破解規則會把所有使用者算在一起，選用的封鎖也會封鎖代理本身。Proxmox Backup Server 4.1.4 以後，若請求來自允許的代理，會從標頭讀取真實的來源位址。請在備份伺服器上加入下面的覆寫設定（標頭與位址依代理實際設定），並在備份時段以外重新啟動 proxmox-backup-proxy：進行中的備份與還原工作階段會中斷。只有 PROXY_REAL_IP_ALLOW_FROM 中的位址可以設定該標頭，連線方無法偽造來源位址。沒有使用代理時不需要這個步驟。
setup.code:
systemctl edit proxmox-backup-proxy
# add:
[Service]
Environment=PROXY_REAL_IP_HEADER=X-Real-IP
Environment=PROXY_REAL_IP_ALLOW_FROM=<proxy address>

systemctl restart proxmox-backup-proxy
setup.verify: Log in through the proxy and check that the last line of /var/log/proxmox-backup/api/access.log starts with your own address, not the proxy's.
setup.verify_zh: 透過代理登入，確認 /var/log/proxmox-backup/api/access.log 最後一行開頭是自己的位址，而不是代理的位址。

setup.title: Settings on the backup server that the rules assume (recommended)
setup.title_zh: 規則所假設的備份伺服器設定（建議）
setup.body: These are the vendor's own recommendations (Proxmox Backup Server documentation, user management and ransomware protection); each makes one of the rules meaningful. Give every Proxmox VE cluster its own API token with only DatastoreBackup on its datastore or namespace: it can create backups but not delete them, so ransomware on a node produces refused deletions (131879, 131880) instead of deleted backups. Enable a second factor for root@pam (131824 to 131826 then report attacks on it). Keep a verification job on every datastore: verification fails when backups are damaged or encrypted (131837, 131859). Do not let an off-site sync job remove vanished snapshots, so a deletion does not propagate. Make sure notifications reach someone (131816 reports when they do not). Remove the garbage collection schedule of a removable datastore that stays unplugged for long, which stops its once-a-minute not mounted line (131811). None of this is changed by the pack.
setup.body_zh: 以下是廠商自己的建議（Proxmox Backup Server 文件的使用者管理與勒索軟體防護章節），每一項都讓某條規則有意義。每個 Proxmox VE 叢集使用自己的 API token，且只在其 datastore 或 namespace 上給 DatastoreBackup：它能建立備份但不能刪除，節點上的勒索軟體只會產生被拒絕的刪除（131879、131880），而不是被刪掉的備份。為 root@pam 啟用第二因素（131824 至 131826 才能回報針對它的攻擊）。每個 datastore 保留一個驗證工作：備份損壞或被加密時驗證會失敗（131837、131859）。異地同步工作不要移除已消失的 snapshot，避免刪除被同步過去。確認通知確實有人收到（送不出去時 131816 會回報）。長期不插上的卸除式 datastore，請移除它的垃圾回收排程，即可停止每分鐘一次的未掛載記錄（131811）。本套件不會變更以上任何設定。
setup.code:
proxmox-backup-manager user list-tokens <user>@pbs
proxmox-backup-manager acl list
proxmox-backup-manager verify-job list
proxmox-backup-manager sync-job list

setup.title: Watch the disk usage of every datastore (optional)
setup.title_zh: 監看每個 datastore 的磁碟用量（選用）
setup.body: Without this step, disk usage is watched only for datastores under /mnt/datastore/. Add the localfile below to the Wazuh agent's own /var/ossec/etc/ossec.conf on the backup server (inside ossec_config) and restart the agent. Every 6 minutes it runs df on each datastore path in /etc/proxmox-backup/datastore.cfg (relative paths of removable datastores are skipped, they are under /mnt/datastore/ anyway), so no list is needed and new datastores are covered. It only reads that file and runs df; nothing changes in Proxmox Backup Server, and restarting the Wazuh agent does not interrupt backups. It has to be the local configuration: a command in a group's agent.conf is refused unless the agent allows remote commands.
setup.body_zh: 未做這個步驟時，只有 /mnt/datastore/ 底下的 datastore 會被監看磁碟用量。請把下面的 localfile 加到備份伺服器上 Wazuh agent 自己的 /var/ossec/etc/ossec.conf（放在 ossec_config 內），再重新啟動 agent。它每 6 分鐘對 /etc/proxmox-backup/datastore.cfg 中每個 datastore 路徑執行 df（卸除式 datastore 的相對路徑會略過，它們本來就在 /mnt/datastore/ 底下），所以不需要清單，新增的 datastore 也會涵蓋。它只讀取該檔案並執行 df；Proxmox Backup Server 不需任何變更，重新啟動 Wazuh agent 也不會中斷備份。必須放在本機設定：群組 agent.conf 中的指令，除非 agent 允許遠端指令，否則會被拒絕。
setup.code:
<localfile>
  <log_format>command</log_format>
  <command>awk '$1=="path" {print $2}' /etc/proxmox-backup/datastore.cfg | grep ^/ | xargs -r df -P</command>
  <alias>jt-pbs-datastores</alias>
  <frequency>360</frequency>
</localfile>

systemctl restart wazuh-agent
setup.verify: Run the command by hand on the server: it prints one df line per datastore filesystem. A datastore at 90 per cent or more raises 131892 (level 10) on the manager within 6 minutes.
setup.verify_zh: 在伺服器上手動執行這個指令：每個 datastore 所在的檔案系統會印出一行 df。用量達 90% 以上的 datastore，6 分鐘內 manager 端會出現 131892（level 10）。

setup.title: List datastore mount points outside /mnt/datastore
setup.title_zh: 列出 /mnt/datastore 以外的 datastore 掛載點
setup.body: An alternative to the command above, for a site that prefers not to change the agent's configuration. For a datastore on a ZFS pool, an NFS share or any disk not formatted by Proxmox Backup Server, add the mount point that holds it (the last column of df -P on the server, not the datastore path below it), one line each, then reload the ruleset. Disk usage alerts start at 90 per cent.
setup.body_zh: 上一個指令的替代做法，適合不想變更 agent 設定的站台。datastore 若放在 ZFS pool、NFS 分享或任何不是由 Proxmox Backup Server 格式化的磁碟上，請把存放它的掛載點（伺服器上 df -P 的最後一欄，不是其下的 datastore 路徑）每行一個加入清單，再重新載入規則集。磁碟用量從 90% 開始告警。
setup.verify: Run df -P on the server and check the mount point is the one listed.
setup.verify_zh: 在伺服器上執行 df -P，確認掛載點與清單一致。

active_response.title: Block an address that keeps failing to log in
active_response.title_zh: 封鎖一再登入失敗的位址
active_response.body: Drops all traffic from the source address on the backup server, for 10 minutes, after six failed password logins in five minutes (rule 131805). It uses iptables or nftables on the server and blocks every port, including 8007, which Proxmox VE nodes use to send backups. Risks: an administrator who mistypes a password six times is locked out of the server for 10 minutes, with everyone behind the same NAT address; if the address is a Proxmox VE node (password logins from a node mean someone is using its shell, or the storage is configured with a password instead of an API token), that node's running and scheduled backups fail until the block expires. Wrong API tokens are a different rule (131804) and never trigger this. Put the management network and every Proxmox VE node address in the manager's white_list first. Since 1.2 the failures are read from syslog: a local user of the backup server can write such lines with logger and get an address blocked, so enable this only on a server without unprivileged shell accounts.
active_response.body_zh: 五分鐘內密碼登入失敗六次（規則 131805）後，在備份伺服器上封鎖來源位址的所有流量 10 分鐘。它在伺服器上使用 iptables 或 nftables，會擋掉所有連接埠，包括 Proxmox VE 節點送備份用的 8007。風險：打錯密碼六次的管理者會被擋在伺服器外 10 分鐘，同一個 NAT 位址後的所有人也一樣；若該位址是 Proxmox VE 節點（節點發出密碼登入，代表有人在用它的 shell，或儲存區設定用的是密碼而非 API token），該節點進行中與排程中的備份會失敗直到封鎖解除。API token 錯誤是另一條規則（131804），不會觸發這個動作。請先把管理網段與所有 Proxmox VE 節點位址加入 manager 的 white_list。自 1.2 起，登入失敗改由 syslog 讀取：備份伺服器上的本機使用者可以用 logger 寫出這種記錄，讓某個位址被封鎖，因此請只在沒有非特權 shell 帳號的伺服器上啟用。

active_response.title: Block an address that keeps probing the API port
active_response.title_zh: 封鎖一再探測 API 連接埠的位址
active_response.body: Drops all traffic from the source address on the backup server, for 10 minutes, after ten malformed connections (failed TLS handshakes, invalid HTTP methods) in two minutes (rule 131819). Risk: the site's own network scanner, inventory tool or a monitoring system that checks port 8007 with a plain TCP connection is blocked the same way, and a monitoring system then reports the server as down. Put those addresses in the manager's white_list first.
active_response.body_zh: 兩分鐘內出現十次異常連線（TLS 交握失敗、無效的 HTTP 方法）（規則 131819）後，在備份伺服器上封鎖來源位址的所有流量 10 分鐘。風險：站台自己的網路掃描器、資產盤點工具，或以單純 TCP 連線檢查 8007 連接埠的監控系統也會被同樣封鎖，監控系統接著會回報伺服器停機。請先把這些位址加入 manager 的 white_list。
